clauses.reason: The order exempts Edgar M. Cohee, chief office clerk, Office of the Collector of Internal Revenue, Los Angeles, California, Treasury Department, from compulsory retirement for age under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, and fixes the period in its own words: "for a period of one year ending April 30, 1942". The end is recorded as April 30, 1942 (1942-04-30), inclusive: the exemption runs through that day. The exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is the alternative. EO 9031, signed January 20, 1942, cites this order by number ("Executive Order No. 8692 of ") and exempts the same employee again: "I hereby further exempt" ... "for a period of one year ending April 30, 1943". It states no separate effective date, so its signature date is recorded as the event date. It is a later event, not an end: it is a new exemption for a later period and does not revoke, shorten or supersede the exemption in EO 8692.
